title: Installation of Washer and Dryer in Greenhouse
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.ANIMAL AND PLANT HEALTH INSPECTION SERVICE.MRPBS MINNEAPOLIS MN
description_text: The AMS Science & Technology Program operates a greenhouse facility requiring the installation of a stacked washer and dryer to support laboratory and operational needs. The program already owns a Samsung front‑load washer and dryer set, which is compatible with stackable installation. A stacking kit needs to be supplied and installed as part of the project. The installation area is located along an exterior wall in the greenhouse entryway. Existing plumbing must be reconfigured, and new electrical, ventilation, and structural modifications are required.
